ios.desc: Network Tree is a networking productivity platform that enables users to unlock the value of their network. Network Tree helps users strategically organize and utilize their network in a more efficient way through features such as reminders, contacts grouping, AI search, and note sections. Users are asked to upload their contacts to app, securly stored in our server, and then have the ability to group, organize and access them.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Network Tree- a Network Management App

quotes.text:
Tired of losing track of important connections? Meet Network Tree, the ultimate networking productivity app designed to help you grow and nurture your relationships effortlessly. Whether you're a student kickstarting your career or a professional juggling countless contacts, Network Tree makes it easy to stay organized, remember to follow up, and craft personalized messages with the help of AI.

Why try Network Tree?
 Smart Algorithms: Automatically organize your contacts into meaningful groups.
 Follow-Up Reminders: Never forget to reach out again.
 Personalized Messaging: Let AI craft thoughtful notes in seconds.
 Career Growth: Designed for students and professionals alike to network like pros.

Download Network Tree today and turn your connections into opportunities. Your network deserves this upgrade!

Available now on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/network-tree-co/id6502738191?platform=iphone
